newsitem.title: USA: Universal acquires stake in October Films.
newsitem.headline: Universal acquires stake in October Films.

text.p: Seagram Co Ltd's Universal Pictures Wednesday announced plans to acquire a majority interest in October Films.

Under terms of the agreement, October Films will keep its headquarters in New York and will continue to acquire, create, market and distribute its films theatrically in the U.S., and internationally in all media.

Universal will distribute October's films in all other domestic media and ancillary markets, including home video as well as pay, free and network television, upon expiration of October's existing distribution agreements.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.

Allen & Co Inc and Siegler, Collery and Co. will remain significant shareholders in October Films. Allen & Co Inc Director John Josephson and Siegler, Collery and Co. President Gary Siegler will remain as members of its board of directors.
October Films is a leading independent distributor of specialized motion pictures, operating principally in North America.
